Maria R.: FYI I pushed a staging bring-up for magnet-16b-int4-compact and ran the longctx kv-sanity suite, found a small but reproducible token drift at swap boundaries.
Aj S.: how small? can you show difflog snippet?
Maria R.: ~1-3 token diffs near the swap boundary, reproducible on deterministic seed. difflog: 
```
[2026-03-24T08:21:11Z] PREFILL start tokens=65528
[2026-03-24T08:21:12Z] PREFILL warmhead done
[2026-03-24T08:21:12Z] KV-SWAP shard=0->1 bytes=131072
[2026-03-24T08:21:12Z] GENERATE idx=65529 expected=\" the\" got=\" then\"
```
Cheng L.: only int4-compact? tried int4-hybrid / int8 / fp16?
Maria R.: int4-hybrid and int8 clean, fp16 clean. int4-compact only.
Priya K.: could be packing alignment or rotary scale quantization per-chunk. compact packer uses per-chunk scales but we accidentally cache a global table during swap.
Oliver P.: yep that matches a recent change where swap path reused rot_scale_buffer pointer. if chunk boundaries change, rot index offsets can be wrong.
Aj S.: can you repro with a tiny harness? i.e. create two chunks with different token counts, pack/unpack and compare kv values to float ref?
Maria R.: wrote a small unit harness, attach snippet: 
```python
# pack two chunks into compact int4 buffer then unpack and compare
def pack_then_unpack(chunk_a, chunk_b):
    buf = pack_compact_int4([chunk_a, chunk_b])
    unpacked = unpack_compact_int4(buf)
    assert np.allclose(unpacked[0], chunk_a_fp32)
    assert np.allclose(unpacked[1], chunk_b_fp32)
```
Maria R.: harness failed: unpacked second chunk had scale mismatch. adding debug prints showed rot_scale table different after unpack.
Cheng L.: try recomputing rot_scale during unpack instead of copying pointer. that fixed a similar bug in the int4 packer months ago.
Maria R.: implemented quick change on branch maria/compact-rot-fix. forced recompute per-chunk on unpack. running fuzz with prefill sweep (16k,64k,131k).
qa-bot: scheduled job long-kv-fuzz on maria/compact-rot-fix (job id: 2026-03-24-2291), ETA 3h.
Aj S.: nice. also add a unit that asserts token-level equality with fp16 baseline for these boundary cases. even if slow it's worth having.
Maria R.: added unit. also found an off-path case where prefill modulo chunk_size != 0 produced a one-byte padding that moved alignment — fixed that too.
Oliver P.: perf note: the recompute adds ~0.02ms per swap in microbench; negligible compared to network / kernel cost. but file a perf ticket so we track aggregate impact.
perf-bot: created perf ticket PF-4123: \"measure kv unpack rot_rescale overhead and aggregate impact\"
Aj S.: after tests pass, let's run the quant matrix (compact int4, hybrid int4, int8, fp16) across the three prefill sizes and capture token-diff counts + p50/p95/p99 latencies. put results in csv.
Maria R.: harness now emits csv columns: model,quant,pre_fill,kv_swapped,token_diffs,lat_p50,lat_p95,lat_p99. will run after fuzz completes.
ci-bot: PR maria/compact-rot-fix -> staging: smoke,long-kv-suite,unit-kv queued.
Maria R.: update: fuzz completed, initial sweep showed diffs dropped to 0 for 16k and 64k, and 0 for 131k after the padding alignment fix. PR up for review.
Cheng L.: great. please include the small unit that intentionally sets misaligned padding to ensure future regressions caught.
Maria R.: added tests + short blurb in PR. scheduling a tiny canary tomorrow on 2 dedicated hosts with verbose diff logs for first hour.
Aj S.: remember to gate verbose logs with env var so we don't blow S3 logs.
Maria R.: yep, canary will only dump diffs to /tmp and push summary.
perf-bot: PF-4123 updated: estimated p50 impact per swap 0.02ms, projected aggregate 0.5% throughput loss under high-swap workloads.
Oliver P.: good to track. prioritize correctness, then optimizations like caching computed scales keyed by (chunk_length, quant_table) if needed.
ci-bot: job maria/compact-rot-fix long-kv-suite passed (job id: 2026-03-25-0410)
Maria R.: CI passed. canary scheduled at 2026-03-25T14:00Z. I'll post results in #eng-ml after run. thanks all :raised_hands:
